propositions: rebar hardcodes DC comment ceiling to 32767 characters via WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT constant, silently truncating comments when a DC administrator has raised jira.text.field.character.limit above that value
the hardcoded 32767 default is correct for stock Jira >= 7.0 but becomes wrong on configured instances, causing silent data loss despite operator warning from sanitizers.py
DC comment ceiling must be configurable with default 32767 and range 0 to 2147483647 to match jira.text.field.character.limit's documented behavior
sanitize_comment previously reused the description fitter (fit_outbound) creating a structural coupling where changes to description fitting rules could silently retarget comment truncation
/rest/api/2/application-properties is admin-only readable and cannot serve as an auto-discovery mechanism for rebar's non-admin PAT credential, so configuration-only remediation is required
